title: Zscaler UVM and SecurityScorecard Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler UVM and SecurityScorecard Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) with the SecurityScorecard platform.
UVM ingests, normalizes, and unifies data across enterprise security and business systems to deliver actionable insights, analytics, and operational efficiencies.
UVM offers the following preconfigured SecurityScorecard connectors:

blocks.item: SecurityScorecard: Retreives information about security issues or vulnerabilities detected within an organization's systems, networks, or applications.
SecurityScorecard Alerts: Retrieves notifications or alerts about potential security incidents or suspicious activities received in your SecurityScorecard account.
